This model represents the Mitsubishi F-2B, a support fighter used by the Japan Air Self-Defense Force, showcasing the aircraft's sleek design and advanced features. Manufactured by Hasegawa, a renowned name in model kit production, this kit promises precision and quality in every piece.

This plastic model kit offers an engaging assembly experience for hobbyists who appreciate realistic military aircraft models. The 1/48 scale provides a balanced size that highlights intricate details while remaining manageable for display. With a total weight of 480 grams, the kit is compact yet substantial, making it a great addition to any model collection.

Details

• Specifications:

  • Plastic Model Kit
  • Assembly Required

• Condition: New

• Product Material: Plastic

• Manufacturer: Hasegawa

• Recommended Age: 15 and up

Features

  • 1/48 scale detailed model of the Mitsubishi F-2B fighter aircraft
  • Manufactured by Hasegawa, known for precision model kits
  • Requires assembly, suitable for experienced model builders
  • Includes detailed parts to accurately represent the aircraft's design
  • Ideal for collectors and aviation enthusiasts

Care instructions

Handle the model kit parts with care during assembly to avoid damage. Use a soft brush or cloth to remove dust from the assembled model. Avoid exposure to direct sunlight to prevent color fading. Store the model in a dust-free display case to maintain its condition.
